name: explain_fact
description: Explain WHY the current fact is what it is for (tenant_id, subject, predicate): current resolution (value, status, policy_version, reason, validity window), the winning source + authority, supporting and CONTRARY evidence references, assessments, superseded/rejected/disputed prior assertions, and the outcome history. Optimized for agent consumption. tenant_id must equal the caller's identity claim.

tenant_id.description: Tenant. Must equal the caller's verified tenant_id claim (enforced by Cedar).

subject.description: The subject/entity key the fact is about.
